q: A subshift of finite type (SFT) is defined by:
opts: A countable set of forbidden words of any length
A finite set of forbidden words (equivalently, by a finite transition matrix)
A finite alphabet with no constraints
exp: An SFT is specified by forbidding a finite list of words. Equivalently, it is defined by a transition (adjacency) matrix A: the SFT consists of all bi-infinite paths on the directed graph with adjacency matrix A.
